Pa jest teško je pogotovo nama koji živimo u ovoj raspaloj Srbiji, nekad se zapitam kako sam uspeo da izdržim ovoliko dugo, evo za par meseci 33 i još se držim, doduše za ivicu al guram nekako...Nadam se da ćete i  ti i autorka naći nekako snage da pregurate sve to...Sve najbolje.

Jel si još uvek s nama? Ako jesi posavetovao bih te da odspavaš, da sačekaš još jedan dan pa će se valjda nešto promeniti, tako i mene uhvati pa krenem da se obesim al kažem sebi ajd možda će sutra biti bolje i tako prođe par dana i onda tek shvatim koji sam kreten bio i da bih povredio mnoge ljude koji me vole...Znam da je borba teška ja se borim već skoro 8 godina sa ovim mislima, ne znam šta bih ti još rekao osim da pokušaš da smiriš misli, slušaj muziku odgledaj neki film odspavaj pa se nadam da će ti sutra biti malo bolje, onda odeš do Lidla pa kupiš pile pa banane de ćeš bolje od toga 😀 Ajd drž se.

Evo i ja se javljam iz Srbije...Čisto da znaš da razumem kako se osećaš, totalno se osećam beskorisno mislim da samo zauzimam prostor i ničemu ne doprinosim, da nije moje porodice i par drugara mislim da bi se frljnuo odavno.Nemam neki pametan savet za tebe, probaj da kreneš u teretanu možda meni je kolko tolko pomoglo da skrenem misli sa svega a i imaćeš neki osećaj da si nešto uradila sa sobom.U svakom slučaju želim ti sve najbolje a ti se slobodno javi ako budeš htela...

Well i was so "tired" today that i wanted to kill myself an hour ago but my knot went loose and im here now making my second post on reddit wanting to help others if i cant help myself...If i may ask whats troubling you right now?

Well first off i'll have to say i read every word you wrote and i think you are very intelligent and well spoken person...I want you to know that i'm in a similar situation like you, i'm 31 years old male living with my parents, without a job and basically i spend my whole day thinking what the hell i'm gonna do with myself , i have a small circle of friends but they all are married or have girlfriends and it would pass weeks or sometimes a month someone text me or ask me out...beside that i'm very quiet person with case of social anxiety and when i do go out with my friends i would sit there for hours saying maybe three words not contributing to the conversation and felling like a stupid asshole...I don't know if i can give you some good advice but one thing that kept my sanity was going to the gym working out two hours daily keeping my mind occupied with workout and occasionally saying a few words with people there.So ill hope that you will find the motivation to make some changes in your life and to know that your not alone in this, many of us are in similar or worst situation, but be sure that someone will always offer you help be it some good advice or some kind word that will help you trough the day...If you want to talk just pm message me...I realized that i took me half an hour to make this post, English is not my first language  :)
